title: Initial enquiry about Ivor Kestell’s estate
text:
2 March 2026

Dear Enquiries team,

I’m writing to ask about an initial probate appointment. Ivor Ellis Kestell died on 18 February 2026. His last address was 9 Barrowglass Walk, Darnmere.

I have the signed original will dated 7 October 2021 and a certified copy of the death entry. The will names me as executor and leaves the residue to me outright.

I asked Merewick Building Society for the date-of-death balance on 27 February and haven’t received it yet.

Could you let me know what I should bring to a first appointment and whether I can come in before the balance arrives? I’d prefer to bring the original will in person rather than post it.

Kind regards,  
Tamsin Vera Kestell

title: Family update list
text:
5 March 2026  
To: Hollin Sedge Legal intake team  
Re: Estate of Ivor Ellis Kestell — family update list

Following my email of 2 March 2026 about an initial probate appointment, this is the complete family update list for Ivor’s estate:

- Leonie Tess Rindle
- Nella Ruth Verrow

I spoke with each separately. Both are living, and each confirmed the spelling of her own current full name and asked me to pass on any general updates.

Please send any general update to me. I’ll pass it on to each of them separately without circulating their contact details. I gave both the same intake-desk route for submitting any correction.

Tamsin Vera Kestell

title: Single-row attendance extract
text:
Darnmere Papers Desk — Attendance register extract  
Copy issued: 13 March 2026  
Nominated packet recipient: Tamsin Vera Kestell

Reference: DP-7316  
Session: 12 March 2026 at 11:20  
Attendees: 1  
Current full name: [not entered]

Each reference belongs to one conversation and is the reference printed on the text issued to the attendee. When completed, the name field records the checked-in attendee’s current full name, copied from the check-in record. It does not record the recipient’s name or the name used to book the session. The register contains no conversation text or record of family relationships.

The value “[not entered]” marks this distributed extract as incomplete. It is not a finding about who attended or whether an identity was checked.

Merrin Vale  
Registration keeper, Darnmere Papers Desk

title: Records sighted and returned at intake
text:
To: Estate intake adviser, Hollin Sedge Legal
From: Orla Fenwick, documents clerk
Documents sighted in person at 14:10 on 26 March 2026

Certified birth entry — Darnmere entry 284 for 1969. The entry names Tamsin Vera Kestell as the child and Ivor Ellis Kestell as the father.

Signed original will — dated 7 October 2021. The will opens by naming Ivor Ellis Kestell of 9 Barrowglass Walk, Darnmere. The executor clause reads “my daughter Tamsin Vera Kestell”. The residue clause names Tamsin Vera Kestell outright.

Certified death entry — the entry names Ivor Ellis Kestell of 9 Barrowglass Walk, Darnmere, and records the date of death as 18 February 2026.

I handed all three papers back at the counter.

title: Intake visit and brief for first substantive meeting
text:
Internal intake note — Estate of Ivor Ellis Kestell
To: Adviser assigned to the first substantive meeting
From: Seth Calder, Estate Intake Adviser, Hollin Sedge Legal
Date: 26 March 2026

For the first substantive meeting, prepare a probate intake summary for Ivor Ellis Kestell’s estate using only material held at 4 pm on 26 March 2026. Set out what the file supports about the people and their family relationships, distinguish reported relationships from those supported by other records, and identify originals and other papers still to obtain.

Estate and documents sighted

Tamsin Vera Kestell made the opening enquiry on 2 March and attended intake with an incomplete folder. The certified death entry records that Ivor Ellis Kestell of 9 Barrowglass Walk, Darnmere, died on 18 February 2026. The signed original will dated 7 October 2021 names Tamsin as executor, describes her as “my daughter” and leaves the residue to her outright. The certified birth entry (Darnmere entry 284 for 1969) names Tamsin as the child and Ivor as the father.

Orla Fenwick sighted all three papers at 14:10 on 26 March and returned them at the counter. The firm retained the sighting slip, not the three papers. No probate application was started at intake.

Family contacts

In her 5 March update, Tamsin gave Leonie Tess Rindle and Nella Ruth Verrow as the complete family-update list. She reported that both were living and that each separately confirmed the spelling of her own current full name. Send general updates through Tamsin for separate relay without circulating their contact details. Both were given the same intake-desk route for corrections.

Darnmere Papers Desk materials — DP-7316

Tamsin brought a printout of the attendance register extract to intake on 26 March. The firm already held Tamsin’s inline forward of the relay message she received on 12 March. She supplied the native .eml export at intake on 26 March. The firm retained the export with the inline forward; both are from the same original message.

Papers still to obtain

Arrange for Tamsin to bring back the signed original will and the certified birth and death entries as needed. Tamsin confirmed at intake that the Merewick Building Society date-of-death balance confirmation, requested on 27 February, had not arrived.
